summary: Frontend-only print flow testing completed on public URL with real orders and temporary API-created orders. Two-product label, single-product label, gift-note PDF rendering, overflow handling, and print lifecycle were validated.

issues: Horizontal table overflow exists on small viewport (baseline issue, not specific to print flow).

action_items: Optional: improve mobile table responsiveness to reduce horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: Print DOM lifecycle is stable: #order-print-root is detached after afterprint and does not persist stale content.
Dynamic print sizing and fit guard works: oversized note content is blocked with Turkish overflow toast instead of truncating/blank output.
No hardcoded API URL in tested print flow components; frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL pattern correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary orders with first_name=TEST_Print for print scenarios; all temporary fixtures cleaned (0 remaining).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated with real order #2 and temporary orders for edge cases. PDFs confirmed one page each with expected dimensions (label ~100x100mm, note ~80x50mm), two-product headings/details present, single-product has no phantom second section, image-blocked note still prints text, overflow note blocked via toast. Temporary test orders were deleted.
rca of the issue: Original blank-note risk is mitigated by body-level print portal + font/image readiness + afterprint cleanup. In validation, note PDFs contained visible text and expected dimensions; when image was blocked, note text still rendered, proving artwork failure no longer suppresses message.
